summary: String Bio's feed ingredient has received validation and adoption from BioMar, a major aquaculture feed producer. The endorsement represents market recognition for the ingredient in the aquaculture sector's pursuit of sustainable feed alternatives.
title: String Bio’s feed ingredient gets the nod from BioMar
title_en: String Bio’s feed ingredient gets the nod from BioMar

summary: BioMar has launched a new additive formulation intended to help salmon farmers manage SRS, a bacterial disease affecting farmed salmon. The product represents the company's effort to address a significant health challenge in aquaculture.
title: BioMar lanza nuevo aditivo para combatir SRS
title_en: BioMar lanza nuevo aditivo para combatir SRS
